title: window-left, round 2
meta: 1 candidate on a tall 9:16 canvas, about 13 cents. All eight checks pass.
note: Asked for a tall canvas, it came back 2.01 times as tall as wide (round 1, square, was 1.47), so at 1.2 m wide it stands 2.42 m against the placeholder's 2.7. A stone transom under the head, two tall lights, the casement with black iron hinges and a brass latch and stay, the owl now filling the roundel with both wingtips on the ring. The glass keys clean. Still off: the owl is filled with colour rather than drawn in line, three saddle bars a light where four were asked, about four quarries across where five were asked.
